source: make a game where everyone gets a role fighter, giant, and shapeshifter make the game have 12 people for each server shapeshifter can shake into anything so they can hide from fighter and giant. giant has ability to throw cars to eliminate every to win fighter has the ability to fight with super nature powers they have to buy powers in the shop and also make coins laying around the whole map when you pick them up make it have a sound affect and a bag for them the limit for how much coins is 50 for new people who is new to this game give them a tutorial on how to play it and also make it playable so they can explore and walk around

image_prompt.text: Buildings, walls and street furniture scattered across the map, giving the shapeshifter places to break line of sight and a retreating fighter somewhere to disengage
Alleys, doorways and bridges that funnel the three roles together into predictable flashpoints

notes: Open World Action was chosen over Battlegrounds because the prompt asks for a map players can explore and walk around rather than a single bounded arena; the stacked shape carries P2 for overhanging levels, which the prompt neither asked for nor rules out.

The three roles are asymmetric with different win conditions, and the genre has no way to express that. Survival carries spawn-protected as Role Assignment Points, but the same ID exists here as anti-camp placement, so loading Survival as a secondary genre would dedupe the role meaning away rather than add it.
Cars have to be throwable props rather than scenery, which is a physics property of geometry no option covers.

open_questions.ask: Cars and streets suggest a modern city - is that right, or did you have another setting in mind?
Should the map have real upper levels - rooftops and walkways - or is one ground level enough?

coverage_missing.ask: How does a round end - last role standing, a timer, or an elimination count?
What setting is the map - a modern city, a town, something else?
How far apart should the hiding areas and the open fighting areas be?
How many of the 12 players are giants and shapeshifters, and where does each role start?

answers.ask: Cars and streets suggest a modern city - is that right, or did you have another setting in mind?
answers.answer: Yes, use a small modern city setting with streets and cars for the giant to throw.

answers.ask: Should the map have real upper levels - rooftops and walkways - or is one ground level enough?
answers.answer: Include real rooftops and a few walkways so shapeshifters have places to hide and players can explore.
